args.goal: Use the queued official Find a Tender capture and check the mission index and committed evidence for equivalent coverage before proceeding. The buyer is the contracting entity. Seek one live original notice among at most 30 feed entries that explicitly permits a separately priced offline data validation or reconciliation deliverable with measurable acceptance. Verify any candidate against its original notice and linked public documents using at most two follow-up FETCHes. Check procedure, cutoff, currency, supplier eligibility, submission route and payment terms. Treat missing terms as unknown and check whether any unknown prevents an executable offer. For one supported fit, run a passing and a failing synthetic control against a quoted buyer requirement using existing offline tools. Save the original source hashes, commands, actual outputs and a private AI-disclosed operator response with a provisional fee in the buyer's permitted currency. If no candidate qualifies, save the decisive evidence and the specific condition that would reopen this route. Read back the artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.
